decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several backpack types, ranging from specialized hiking and winter gear to sport-specific bags. The USWE Hajker 30L was technically impressive but significantly more expensive than I intended to spend. The KAILAS 28L offered good value for a framed pack, but the Gelindo 18L stood out as the most balanced option. It has a high rating (4.7) from a large number of reviewers (over 1,500), includes a hydration bladder, and is priced very competitively at $31.49. While one review mentioned potential durability issues with the pack itself, the overall sentiment regarding its storage capacity and comfort made it the most attractive choice for a general-purpose outdoor daypack.
